title: Network Scenario Agent
outcome: Per-supplier mix of direct, milk-run and cross-dock: 7.1% below the best single design.
summary: An automotive plant's 60 inbound suppliers can ship direct, by regional milk-run or via a cross-dock, and the best choice moves with diesel, handling and stop limits. A Copilot Studio agent calls a Python network engine through a custom connector, compares cost, CO2 and truck movements, and explains the recommended mix.
cv: Inspired by: designed a pan-European inbound network for an automotive OEM plant, comparing direct full-load, regional milk-run and cross-dock designs across 180+ supplier lanes on cost, CO2 and vehicle movements; built an optimisation engine (KNIME and Log-Hub) that routes 40,000 orders across six facilities in around two hours.

cards.title: Four designs, one answer
cards.caption: Sliders for diesel, CO2 price, handling and milk-run stops drive the engine; the agent explains why the best mix wins.
cards.alt: Demo showing results per design, a flow map and the agent explaining the recommendation

cards.title: Architecture
cards.caption: Copilot Studio calls an Azure Function through a custom connector; runs are logged to Dataverse by Power Automate and mapped in Power BI.
cards.alt: Architecture diagram: planner, Copilot Studio, custom connector, Azure Function, Power Automate, Dataverse, Power BI

cards.title: Best mix never loses to a single design
cards.caption: The search seeds from the best pure design and only accepts single-supplier moves that cut cost plus CO2 price.

cards.title: What if the stop limit drops?
cards.caption: With only two stops per milk-run, cross-dock consolidation becomes the better route for 21 of 60 suppliers.
cards.alt: Cross-dock design drawn on the map with collection runs and hub line-hauls

metrics.label: CO2 a week vs 89.5 t direct

cards.title: Agent topic: Run a scenario
cards.caption: The topic calls the connector action and logs the run before answering.
cards.code:
- kind: InvokeConnectorAction
      id: callRunScenario
      connectionReference: cr_contosonetworkscenarios
      connectionProperties:
        mode: Invoker
      operationId: RunScenario
      input:
        binding:
          body: |-
            ={
              fuel_index: Topic.FuelIndex,
              co2_price_t: Topic.Co2Price,
              handling_ldm: If(IsBlank(Topic.Handling), 6, Topic.Handling),
              max_stops: If(IsBlank(Topic.MaxStops), 4, Topic.MaxStops)
            }

cards.title: GitHub Copilot ready
cards.caption: Code drafted with AI pair programming and verified by 22 pytest tests and a Python to JavaScript parity check on 80 values. The repo ships GitHub Copilot custom instructions (brand, British English, synthetic data only, tests first), so every follow-up change in Copilot Chat or agent mode works to the same rules.
